description: Convex optimisation is an indispensable technique in dealing with high-dimensional structured problems in data science. The course covers modelling examples; basic concepts for convex functions and sub-gradients; gradient and sub-gradient methods; accelerated proximal gradient methods; stochastic block coordinate descent methods; Lagrangian duals; splitting algorithms and implementations.
